title.narrative: Grant disbursement to support the film screening

description.narrative: The 22 nd edition of IIFF was held under the theme ‘Women Make The World A Better Place’ from the 22nd to the 26th of August 2025. The festival screened fifteen films from 16 different countries around the world at four different venues in Harare. A wide range of people attended the five-day festival, including local filmmakers, international filmmakers, public audiences, corporate executives, members of the diplomatic corps, government officials, and art practitioners. The festival hosted two of the filmmakers of the international films programmed and some local ones as well , enabling them to interact with audiences during Q&As, and during other festival events.
